verdict.rationale: LibreChat is a self-hosted web chat UI, but it documents a beta Agent Management API that lets machine clients authenticate through deployment-bound OIDC identities and create, update or delete agents programmatically. That is some product-native support for non-interactive automation, though limited to agent management. Docker, npm and Helm installs are deployment methods, not headless operation, and the Scheduled Chats and OpenAPI items are bare titles or probes with no detail, so neither is credited. Missing for 10: documented headless or CLI execution of chats and agents, CI integration guidance, API coverage beyond beta agent management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Agent Management API (beta): Create, discover, update, and delete Agents; manage Agent files and Skills; and authenticate machine clients through deployment-bound OIDC identities
